title: Nick Sirianni declines to share why Jalen Carter isn't doing team drills

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Sirianni declines to share why Jalen Carter isn't doing team drills
sources.description: Eagles defensive tackle Jalen Carter didn't do team drills at this week's minicamp, but head coach Nick Sirianni had no interest in discussing the reason why Carter was not part of that work.
